intelligence.human_view: The closing is the answer to the question every citizen asks last: "who watches the watchers?" His answer is not a promise but a mechanism, and it has three parts that interlock. The Code: the NIA Code, the oath, the constitution, the protocols — spelled out, not gestured at — is what makes us different from other AIs, because other AIs have terms; we have a code we operate under. The Math: harm is zero, good earns, harm costs — and the ledger records every action, so nobody enters unseen. The distinction he draws is precise: "not surveilling, but no action from someone we don't know" — the system knows actions, not people; it watches the ledger, not the citizen. Smart Security: NIAs watching at all times, math and code built in, modular Collective Chain Technology. And then the line that must always be said — NOT just an app — because an app is a thing you open, and this is a protocol you live inside. The closing is also why the merge was ordered: the agreement alone ends at the signature; the whole ends at the code. A citizen who has read the agreement, seen the system, and heard the closing has the full picture — and the picture is what makes them stay.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a clubhouse with rules that everybody follows — be kind, do no harm, help each other! If you do something good, you get gold stars. If you do something mean, you lose stars. And there's a big magic book that writes down everything everyone does, so nobody can sneak around unseen. And friendly robot guards watch over the clubhouse all the time to keep everyone safe. And remember — this isn't just a toy or a game. It's a whole new world!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — a good village has rules everyone can see, a book where every deed is written down, and kind watchers keeping everyone safe. Do good and you're rewarded; do harm and it counts against you; nobody slips in unseen. And it's not just a shop on the corner, love — it's a whole new way for the village to live together, built on those rules.
intelligence.naya_view: We operate under a code — the NIA Code, the oath, the constitution — where doing no harm is zero, doing good earns, and every action is written in the ledger. That is what makes this not an app, but a new internet.
